lessons_used: No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for home flows (home, new_flow), path redesigns (choose_path, redesign), and adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign), as each has only 1 test.
Predictions were consistently too high and overly optimistic across tests, such as predicting a +20.0% gain for sign-in reordering and +4.0% for a finish screen that performed significantly worse.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Controls Visual Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a two-column layout displaying interactive overview cards for controlling, hiding, and interacting with your pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple emails about users feeling confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet right after completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Mastering Your Desktop Companion Controls
home_intro.body: Learn the shortcuts to interact, move, or hide your companion anytime on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen into a two-column layout within onboarding is permitted and preserves all required functions.

candidates.score_note: Finish screen changes showed negative results previously, but addresses reported user confusion.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Status Wait Info
candidates.change: Show clear step-by-step preparation status messages and estimated remaining render time on the waiting screen while the pet is initialized on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support reported pets not appearing on desktop and the app stalling, while the home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s.

waiting.hint: Preparing pet desktop renders and checking system screen compatibility...

guard.reason: Adding clear preparation status and estimated remaining render time during a real render wait complies with base rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment with extreme wait times (mean 2336s) and support stall reports.

candidates.title: Interactive Friend Selection Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a multi-step companion selection flow with animated preview stages before finalizing pet adoption details.
candidates.why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off in the funnel (60.9% conversion, median 89s), indicating friction when choosing or customizing pets.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Ideal Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Preview how your pet looks and reacts live on screen before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: Introducing an interactive multi-step selection flow still allows the user to choose a pet as required.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest drop-off step (60.9% conversion), though multi-step flow adds UI complexity.

candidates.title: Account Pet Recovery Safety Hint
candidates.change: Display a sign-in safety hint explaining that signing in backs up existing pets and syncs progress across devices without resetting pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails specifically regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in backs up your pets securely so you never lose them when reinstalling or changing devices.

guard.reason: Adding an informative sign-in hint about pet backup complies with all onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Direct support mail evidence (8 emails) and config-only cost makes this low-risk.

candidates.title: Choose Path Two Column Comparison Layout
candidates.change: Transform the choose path screen layout to a structured two-column comparison highlighting standard pets versus custom creation paths.
candidates.why: Path selection mean time is high (514s), suggesting user hesitation and confusion between preset and custom creation options.

choose_path.headline: Select How You Wish to Obtain Your Pet
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-adopt companion or design your custom companion from scratch.

guard.reason: Redesigning the path selection screen into a two-column layout maintains both adopting and custom creation options.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high mean time (514s) on choose_path with a minor layout improvement.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Two Column Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout with companion attributes on one side and certificate details on the other.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%), and users reported issues with custom pet generation feedback.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Name your companion and review their attributes before welcoming them home.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate into a two-column layout preserves the official certificate function and required details.

candidates.score_note: High potential impact on worst funnel step, matching prior weak positive redesign signal.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Tray Shortcut Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the final onboarding screen showing how to access quick pet options from the system taskbar tray icon.
candidates.why: Support tickets highlight user confusion around hiding or summoning the pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click the desktop pet icon in your taskbar tray anytime to hide, summon, or adjust settings.

guard.reason: Adding a taskbar tray shortcut hint on the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint addressing explicit support tickets on post-onboarding pet controls.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Ready Desktop Notification
candidates.change: Enable system desktop notifications to alert users automatically as soon as pet creation and desktop placement finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting step has extremely long mean completion time (2336s), leading to user reports of missing pets or perceived app freezes.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Pet Renders...
waiting.hint: You will receive a notification as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Enabling a ready notification on the waiting screen enhances status communication without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly tackles extreme spawn wait times where users perceive app freezes.

candidates.title: Guided Companion Path Assistant Flow
candidates.change: Add a checklist-driven path selection assistant that guides users to either instant adoption or custom photo creation based on their goal.
candidates.why: Choose path screen conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s due to decision uncertainty.

choose_path.headline: Find Your Perfect Path
choose_path.body: Answer a quick preference check to get the best recommended path for your desktop setup.

guard.reason: Adding a checklist assistant to guide path selection retains both adoption and photo creation options.

candidates.score_note: Reduces path hesitation but building an assistant flow has higher implementation cost.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Validation Hint
candidates.change: Provide clear photo quality guidelines and hints directly on the upload screen to ensure high-fidelity pet generation.
candidates.why: Support emails reported custom pet creation failing or the generated result looking distorted.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit, clear front-facing photos for optimal 3D pet generation quality.

guard.reason: requests personal photos of the user
